Jo — Talent: Both principals are available jointly only on August 12, 13, and 14, and their agreement requires joint recording sessions, which conflicts with the draft plan's separate remote sessions. Your clearance findings are complete but dates aren't on the calendar yet.

All three of you have flagged real conflicts with the draft production plan, and all three have complete clearance findings but outstanding filing/documentation tasks. Before I can record a binding decision, I need to confirm: are all three of you submitting these as your formal clearance findings for this greenlight sign-off? I want to make sure we're completing the standard disclosure step properly before I settle the package.
